title: The Wild Robot
author: Peter Brown
summary: A robot washes ashore on a wild island and must learn from its animals. Roz discovers that survival can begin with kindness and unexpected friendships.

title: Dinosaurs Before Dark
author: Mary Pope Osborne
summary: Jack and Annie discover a tree house filled with books that can carry them through time. Their first journey lands them among dinosaurs, far from home.

title: James and the Giant Peach
author: Roald Dahl
summary: James finds a giant peach and a wonderfully unusual group of insect companions. Together they set off on a journey that takes them far beyond his lonely home.

title: The Phantom Tollbooth
author: Norton Juster
summary: Bored Milo drives through a mysterious tollbooth into a world built from words and numbers. Puzzles, jokes and unexpected companions help him discover the fun of learning.

title: My Father's Dragon
author: Ruth Stiles Gannett
summary: Elmer travels to Wild Island with a backpack and a plan to rescue a young dragon. Clever thinking helps him face the animals standing in his way.

title: Matilda
author: Roald Dahl
summary: Matilda loves books and has a mind full of extraordinary ideas. With help from a kind teacher, she discovers the courage to stand up to cruel adults.

title: The BFG
author: Roald Dahl
summary: Sophie meets a giant who catches dreams instead of eating children. An unlikely friendship leads to a daring plan to stop his frightening neighbours.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: Four children step through a wardrobe into a land trapped in winter. Talking animals and a mysterious lion draw them into an adventure about courage and loyalty.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
summary: A cyclone carries Dorothy and Toto to the colourful land of Oz. She follows a yellow brick road with three new friends, each hoping to find something important.

title: Grandma's Bag of Stories
author: Sudha Murty
summary: During a visit to their grandparents, children gather around Ajji to hear her stories. Clever animals, surprising kingdoms and magical happenings fill this collection of Indian tales.

title: Five on a Treasure Island
author: Enid Blyton
summary: Julian, Dick and Anne spend a holiday with their cousin George and her dog, Timmy. A nearby island draws the five friends into a search for hidden treasure.

title: The Boxcar Children
author: Gertrude Chandler Warner
summary: Four siblings make a home in an abandoned railway car and look after one another. As they build a new life, a mystery about their family begins to unfold.

title: Nate the Great
author: Marjorie Weinman Sharmat
summary: Young detective Nate takes on the case of a missing picture. He follows clues, asks careful questions and shows how small details can solve a mystery.

title: Encyclopedia Brown, Boy Detective
author: Donald J. Sobol
summary: Leroy Brown uses his remarkable memory to solve puzzling cases around his town. Each short mystery invites readers to examine the clues before checking the solution.

title: The Secret Seven
author: Enid Blyton
summary: Seven friends form a secret club with passwords, meetings and a taste for adventure. Suspicious activity gives them a real mystery to investigate together.

title: The Magic School Bus Inside the Human Body
author: Joanna Cole
summary: Miss Frizzle's class takes a fantastical trip inside a human body. Their unusual journey introduces the organs and systems that keep us going.

title: The Magic School Bus Lost in the Solar System
author: Joanna Cole
summary: A class outing becomes a journey through space aboard Miss Frizzle's remarkable bus. The children explore the solar system while trying to get everyone safely home.

title: The Way Things Work
author: David Macaulay and Neil Ardley
summary: Illustrated explanations open up the machines and inventions around us. Friendly mammoths and playful diagrams make gears, electricity and modern technology easier to explore.

title: The Magic School Bus Inside the Earth
author: Joanna Cole
summary: Miss Frizzle takes her class beneath the ground on an extraordinary field trip. Rocks, layers of Earth and the planet's interior become part of their adventure.

title: Knowledge Encyclopedia Space!
author: DK
summary: Explore planets, stars, galaxies and the spacecraft that help us study them. Detailed illustrations turn big questions about the universe into discoveries to browse.

title: Charlotte's Web
author: E. B. White
summary: A young pig named Wilbur finds a loyal friend in Charlotte, a thoughtful spider. Her remarkable plan brings a farmyard community together in a story about friendship and change.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
summary: Mary Lennox discovers a locked garden after moving to a large house in Yorkshire. As she makes friends and tends the plants, the garden changes more than its flowers.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh
author: A. A. Milne
summary: Pooh and his friends find small adventures in the Hundred Acre Wood. These gentle stories turn honey, friendship and everyday misunderstandings into something memorable.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
summary: Alice follows a white rabbit into a world where ordinary rules seem to disappear. Strange conversations and impossible situations invite readers to play with logic and language.

title: The Blue Umbrella
author: Ruskin Bond
summary: Binya treasures a beautiful blue umbrella in her Himalayan village. When it attracts another person's envy, a simple possession becomes a story about generosity.

title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
author: Shel Silverstein
summary: Playful poems introduce impossible creatures, surprising children and wonderfully strange situations. Drawings and wordplay invite readers to read aloud and let their imaginations wander.

title: A Light in the Attic
author: Shel Silverstein
summary: A collection of comic poems turns everyday thoughts into surprising little adventures. Funny drawings and unusual characters make each page a new place to explore.

title: Falling Up
author: Shel Silverstein
summary: These short poems find silliness and surprise in unlikely places. Invented characters, playful pictures and unexpected endings reward curious readers.

title: A Child's Garden of Verses
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: Poems revisit childhood through swings, shadows, make-believe journeys and outdoor discoveries. Their rhythms make them enjoyable to share and read aloud.

title: Revolting Rhymes
author: Roald Dahl
summary: Familiar fairy tales take mischievous turns in this collection of rhyming stories. Expect surprising endings and the author's dark, playful sense of humour.
